Your body has its own cooling system. Who knew? ❄️

Testicles work best about two degrees cooler than the rest of the body. When it's cold they pull up closer for warmth, and when it's hot they drop down to cool off.

That's why regular hot tubs, and laptops on your lap, can lower sperm count for a while.

Sources: McGill Office for Science and Society, Turek Clinic, Columbia Go Ask Alice.

Did you know this, or is your mind blown?
